purpose: Persistent regression ledger for NEO HunyuanVideo 1.5 T2V. Every new fix must add a regression guard before another paid GPU run.

known_failures.signature: SLOW_GPU_HOST: 16.45 MB/s; rerent search was restricted to the first 50 GPU offers
known_failures.root_cause: The runner applied GPU-model, RAM and disk filters in the Vast API query and requested only 50 offers. It therefore did not first inspect the broad available GPU market and filter compatibility locally. In addition, the old RAM thresholds compared MB-valued Vast fields against 14 and 48 rather than 14*1024 and 48*1024.
known_failures.fix_or_status: Implemented broad verified/rentable market discovery (up to 1000 returned offers) without server-side GPU-model or hardware compatibility filters, followed by local compatibility, price, reliability, blacklist and attempted-offer filtering. GPU/system RAM thresholds now convert 14GB/48GB to MB correctly. API contract documents a limit but no cursor pagination for this endpoint, so this is a broad 1000-offer search, not a guarantee that a market larger than the API result limit is exhaustively enumerated. Keep budget/runtime/network caps unchanged. Instance teardown confirmation remains a separate outstanding hardening item.

known_failures.signature: SLOW_GPU_HOST: 54.07 MB/s below strict 65 MB/s minimum; retry found zero eligible offers
known_failures.root_cause: The rented RTX 5060 Ti host measured 54.07 MB/s on the pre-download throughput probe. The host was blacklisted and destroyed; the current offer set then had no eligible non-blacklisted offers.
known_failures.fix_or_status: No code relaxation. Keep the 65 MB/s floor. Retry is bounded by the shared deadline and must not rent a blacklisted host. This run did not download the model or generate a video.

known_failures.signature: SLOW_GPU_HOST: 64.12 MB/s below strict 65 MB/s minimum
known_failures.root_cause: The selected host was 0.88 MB/s below the configured minimum. The host was blacklisted and destroyed; remaining offers were excluded.
known_failures.fix_or_status: Retain strict throughput policy; do not silently lower the threshold. Distinguish a measured slow host from an inconclusive probe in logs.

known_failures.signature: Network probe timeout was not retried by the outer failure handler
known_failures.root_cause: Retry marker was not recognized from the exception path.
known_failures.fix_or_status: Retry markers are included in raised exception text and local attempted-offer state is preserved across execv.

known_failures.signature: Cloudflare HTTP 403 and missing GitHub context for blacklist persistence
known_failures.root_cause: Single speed-test endpoint was blocked and the runner lacked explicit GitHub token/repository environment values.
known_failures.fix_or_status: Probe has multiple endpoints; inconclusive probes are not treated as measured slow throughput. Workflow passes GITHUB_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY.

known_failures.signature: SSH/NVIDIA readiness succeeded late but boot loop did not classify probe retry correctly
known_failures.root_cause: SSH endpoint readiness and instance status were not handled independently.
known_failures.fix_or_status: Probe SSH and nvidia-smi during status polling; continue across endpoint failures and wait for readiness.

invariants: Never reduce the 65 MB/s minimum without explicit user approval.
Never exceed $0.10/hour, $0.50 default total budget, or one-hour runtime defaults/caps.
A host with measured throughput below 65 MB/s must be blacklisted before retry.
A timeout or unavailable speed-test endpoint is inconclusive and must not be permanently blacklisted as slow.
Destroy the current paid instance before retrying another host.
Retries share the original runtime deadline; do not reset the clock.
Preserve SSH endpoint fallback and verify nvidia-smi before proceeding.
The real Hugging Face download watchdog independently enforces the 65 MB/s rolling throughput floor.
After a measured slow host is blacklisted, retry must select a distinct eligible offer when one exists; refreshing the same first page is not sufficient.
Do not set the active instance to cleared and rent a replacement merely because DELETE was accepted; poll and confirm terminal teardown state first.
Search the broad verified/rentable GPU market before applying GPU model, VRAM, system RAM, disk, reliability and price compatibility filters locally.
Vast offer discovery requests up to 1000 results; do not claim complete enumeration beyond the documented API result limit because the bundles endpoint schema exposes limit but no cursor pagination.
After a measured slow host is blacklisted, rerun the same broad market search and select a distinct compatible offer when one is returned.
GPU RAM and system RAM returned by Vast are MB values; compare 14GB and 48GB requirements as 14*1024 and 48*1024 MB.
